product_metadata.title: 2 Tier Fruit Basket, Heavy Duty Fruit Bowl, Countertop Bread Snacks Vegetables Basket, Detachable Display Stand, Kitchen Storage Organizer Holder, with Wooden Handle, Black
features: Heavy Duty Metal Fruit Basket: Made of heavy duty metal material, can holds 50LBS; keeping your fruits organized and displayed perfectly

Detachable 2-Tier Basket: You can combine the two baskets to use, or separated into two baskets individually that fits your storage space; Each basket features four circular stand base support on the bottom, which provides stable support; You can storage bread in one area, and display fruit in another

Multi-Function: Perfect organizer for you; This two-tiered basket is a great size for storing and displaying fruits, vegetables, breads and snacks etc; It fits perfectly on counter or cabinet in your kitchen, living room, bathroom or anywhere
Easy To Assemble: Screw free installation design, you can assemble it within few minutes
Dimension: Overall Product Size: 13" L X 7.5" W X 15.2" H; Top basket size: 11.2" L x 6.7" W x 4" H; Bottom basket size: 12" L x 7.5" W x 4" H
